Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Patient ≥ 7 years old
  -  Patient affiliated to a social security system
  -  Giving their informed consent for the study (adults, parents of minors)
  -  Patients with PAH associated with congenital heart disease requiring cardiac catheterization  [AND] and 2D MRI for the diagnosis or follow-up of PAH associated with congenital heart disease
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  ➢ Patient < 7 years old
       -  Pregnant woman
       -  Contraindications to MRI (claustrophobia, intraocular metal foreign bodies, [OR]  pacemaker, [OR]  neurostimulator, [OR]  cochlear implants, old heart valves)
       -  Contraindication to gadolinium injection (allergy, renal failure  [AND] with DFG < 30 ml/min/1

73m²)
       -  Hemodynamically unstable patients
       -  Refusal to participate
